mission: Verify and restore stroke-heuristic parity between packages/swing-lab/src/strokeHeuristic.ts (stroke-heuristic-4 after e03) and the mobile port packages/vision-geometry/src/strokeHeuristicLite.ts (D-036 byte-equivalent-semantics contract).

missingV4GatesPorted: MIN_WINDOW_SPEED_SAMPLES=3: non-swing speed gate fires only on >=3 MEASURED in-window samples; 1-2 samples record speed_window_sparsely_sampled_gate_not_applicable; empty window slice never fires
TORSO_COLLAPSE_MEDIAN_RATIO=0.6 / TORSO_MEDIAN_MIN_FRAMES=5: reference torso extent below 0.6x sequence median abstains (torso_extent_collapsed_vs_sequence_median), medianTorsoExtent() added
rivalMeasuredFrames in dominantWristInfo: rival wrist with 0 measured frames +/-200ms abstains (dominant_wrist_attribution_unverifiable_rival_unmeasured)
intentionalLiteDifferencesPreserved: HeuristicPaddleObservation.confidence is optional; missing confidence treated as below PADDLE_POINT_CONFIDENCE_FLOOR (documented mobile shape)
no legacyFrames precompute parameter (lab-only optimization; identical semantics when omitted)

parityTest.method: identical fixtures run through both classifyStroke implementations; full prediction objects (label, leaf, depth, confidence, evidence strings, limitingFactors, provenance) asserted deeply equal, so one-sided drift fails CI
branchesCovered: no reference, no nearby pose frame
degenerate torso, v4 median torso collapse
v3 no-swing-energy, v4 empty-window slice, v4 sparse window (<3 samples)

datasetScope: no dataset labels touched; synthetic hand-built pose fixtures + generateSwingSequence only; held-out cases untouched
